scope: Real mobile controllers/engine, transactional undo and popup flows in isolated VM. No browser/device/layout QA.

results.name: Every main phone HUD button has an SVG, an accessible name and no text label
Facility map selection opens no popup; production card submits one order in one tap
Production locks unavailable tiers and unaffordable models with explanatory tooltips
Upgrade and paid rebuild icons reach the engine and charge the correct currencies
Deployment uses an icon then one map tap, saves the setting and closes its popup
Unit details are opt-in and X or backdrop dismisses without a command
Ordinary modal X and outside click dismiss; campaign dialogue outside click cannot skip progression
Every active special skill has a distinct pictogram on the right and no basic action buttons
Self skills execute immediately from their pictograms without another map tap
Targeted piercing skill executes on the next target tap without confirmation
Enemy unit tap attacks immediately and basic capture completes by tapping the selected unit tile
Undo restores movement, cumulative road budget, resources, statistics and saved checksum
Undo reverts automatic occupation, discarded enemy orders and stock
Undo returns the automatically deployed FIFO head to storage and prevents stacking
Two consecutive moves can be undone in reverse order; selection and details do not clear history
A successful production or turn handoff invalidates undo; an illegal command does not
Explored terrain and already known enemies remain known after safe undo; active time does not rewind
A move triggering campaign dialogue is a progression boundary and cannot be undone
Readback loads committed position with no stale undo; neither duplicate taps nor redo refund twice
